RegistrationInfo.Description: W365 thin client (SCRIPT-FREE, v2): log off the local IoT session when exiting Modern Standby (Kernel-Power 507) ONLY if the exit Reason is Lid (15), Power Button (1), Input Keyboard (31), Input Touchpad (33), or User Input (4) AND the standby lasted longer than 120 seconds (EventData DurationInUs > 120000000 microseconds - the floor is evaluated inside the trigger query, no script). Reason codes verified on Bruce's pilot build Oct 12, 2026 (Verify-PilotEvents.ps1, 300-event sample, DurationInUs present 300/300).

EventTrigger.Subscription: <QueryList><Query Id="0" Path="System"><Select Path="System">*[System[Provider[@Name='Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power'] and (EventID=507)] and EventData[(Data[@Name='Reason']=15 or Data[@Name='Reason']=1 or Data[@Name='Reason']=31 or Data[@Name='Reason']=33 or Data[@Name='Reason']=4) and Data[@Name='DurationInUs']>120000000]]</Select></Query></QueryList>
